tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The desk: the rail, the page around the sheet, the landing page. Visibly tinted so the paper reads. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-2`, `ink-3`.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The main canvas inside the shell: the inset working surface every page sits on. Text on it: every ink.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, rows' raised containers, inputs, popovers and the command bar: the near-white layer on `sheet`. Text on it: every ink.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: segmented tracks, code, empty states. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-2`, `ink-3`.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Row and quiet-button hover fill. Never a resting state.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: The selected row, the active nav item, the chosen review item. `ink`, `ink-2`, `ink-3` stay ≥ 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The overnight surface: the Dream edition and the terminal, nothing else. Text on it: `night-ink`, `night-ink-2`, `night-accent`, `night-ochre`, `night-vermilion`. In Carbon it is a deep green set off by `night-line`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the ledger rule beside the receipt rail. Decorative — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control: inputs, secondary buttons, segmented tracks, stamps. 3:1 on `paper`, `sheet`, `card` and `well` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button fill. On every surface and wash.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and unconfirmed (italic) statements. On `paper`, `sheet`, `card`, `well`, `hover`, `select`.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Receipts, meta and placeholders — the smallest legible ink, ≥ 4.8:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (the primary button, a person's stamp).

tokens.name: night-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `night`.

tokens.name: night-ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and receipts on `night`.

tokens.name: night-line
tokens.usage: Rules inside `night`, and its edge in Carbon.

tokens.name: night-accent
tokens.usage: Kept, on `night`: the facts Dream produced and the terminal's kept and in-sync lines.

tokens.name: night-ochre
tokens.usage: Waiting on you, on `night`: a Dream item that needs a person, the terminal's proposed lines.

tokens.name: night-vermilion
tokens.usage: Conflict, on `night`.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Kept — text and marks. The seal stamp, in-sync and verified status. Never decoration. On every surface.

tokens.name: seal-fill
tokens.usage: The Keep button's fill and the seal stamp's ink in Carbon, deeper than `seal` so it never outshouts the page. Text on it: `on-seal`.

tokens.name: seal-wash
tokens.usage: Tint behind a just-kept confirmation. Text on it: `ink` or `seal`.

tokens.name: on-seal
tokens.usage: Text on `seal-fill`.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Waiting on you: the proposed mark, pending text, a question an agent asked you. Never for waiting on an agent. On every surface and `ochre-wash`.

tokens.name: ochre-wash
tokens.usage: Behind quarantined external content and drifted files. Text on it: `ink` or `ochre`.

tokens.name: ochre-fill
tokens.usage: The Review count badge only. Text on it: `on-ochre`.

tokens.name: on-ochre
tokens.usage: Text on `ochre-fill`.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Conflict and destruction: the conflict mark, Forget, Overwrite, removed words. On every surface and `vermilion-wash`.

tokens.name: vermilion-wash
tokens.usage: Behind a conflict and the removed side of a diff. Text on it: `ink` or `vermilion`.

tokens.name: redact
tokens.usage: The redaction bar and forgotten mark. Ink on Paper; a quiet grey on Carbon so forgetting never becomes the brightest thing on screen. 3:1 on `card` and `sheet`.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The highlighter behind recall matches inside serif text. `ink` text only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px `focus` outside a 2px `paper` gap — 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the page behind the command bar and dialogs.

families.sans: "Schibsted Grotesk", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans SC", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Wordmark
groups.note: Gloock, a high-contrast display serif, is reserved for the name beside the mark. Its weight matches the mark’s heavy rounded strokes. It never sets headlines or interface text.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name in the logo lockup, capitalised. The mark sits beside it at 1.04× its cap height, centred on the cap height, 0.30× the cap height away. Use the Logo component or the lockup SVGs rather than setting it by hand.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Newsreader at large optical sizes. Titles of places and documents — never of controls.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Landing headlines and a Brief's name on its cover. One per view.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles: Today's date, a Brief, a memory's space.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside Briefs and on Today; the Dream headline.

groups.name: Memory
groups.note: What is remembered is always set in the serif. Roman means kept; italic means an agent proposed it and nobody has confirmed it.

styles.name: memory-lg
styles.sample: Background jobs run on River, not Temporal.
styles.usage: The statement in focus: memory detail, the review card, a decision gate's question.

styles.name: memory
styles.usage: A kept memory in a list row, a handoff, an answer.

styles.name: memory-proposed
styles.sample: Deploy the v2 API to Fly.io in iad and ams.
styles.usage: A proposed memory — italic until a person keeps it. Colour `ink-2`.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Memax V2 is the context layer every agent on the team reads before it writes code.
styles.usage: Body of a Brief and long answers. Keep lines within `measure`.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Schibsted Grotesk runs the machine around the memory: navigation, controls, tables, labels. Sentence case, always.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles, table headers that name a section.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default interface text: nav, descriptions, menus.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, the active nav item, an emphasised name in a sentence.

styles.name: ui-sm
styles.sample: Last read 14 min ago by Cursor
styles.usage: Secondary interface text, table cells, hints under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, counts. Never all-caps.

groups.name: Receipt
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono is the voice of provenance and only that: receipt lines, IDs, paths, commands and the seal ring. Breadcrumbs, counters and labels are sans.

styles.name: receipt
styles.usage: Receipts on every memory: agent, action, time, source, ID. Colour `ink-3`.

styles.name: receipt-strong
styles.usage: The ID or agent monogram that leads a receipt; stamps.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, file paths (CLAUDE.md), inline code and the terminal.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Rows and controls snap to 8; text blocks breathe in 24 and 32.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside stamps and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; the inset around the main sheet.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding block; gap between a mark and its statement.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding inline; card padding on dense surfaces.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Review card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on reading surfaces; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutters inside the sheet; space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between page title and first section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of a page inside the sheet.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between major sections of a Brief or the landing page.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Landing-page section rhythm.

radius.note: Paper corners: small and exact. Only counts and presence dots are round.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Agent stamps, keycaps, highlights, the redaction bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, rows in a card, review and handoff slips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The main sheet, the command bar, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count badges and presence dots only.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. Exactly one floating layer exists at a time.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The command bar, menus, popovers — the one layer above the sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-drag
tokens.usage: A row being dragged between spaces or into a handoff.

size.note: Fixed measures of the shell and controls.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and inputs in rows and toolbars.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and nav item height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on empty states, onboarding and the landing page.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: Width of the navigation rail.

tokens.name: receipt-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the receipt column at the right of every memory row.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of serif reading text (Briefs, answers).

duration.note: Things settle like paper laid on a desk — no bounce, no glow.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Rows entering, panels opening, the command bar.

tokens.name: duration-settle
tokens.usage: A row leaving the review queue; a kept memory cross-fading from italic to roman.

tokens.name: duration-dream
tokens.usage: The Dream compaction: many note lines drawing into few fact bars, once per digest.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Entering and settling motion.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: State changes that stay in place (hover, toggle, segmented).

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Leaving: a rejected proposal, a closing panel.
